texts: mixed: every participant and role is captured and the rule fires, but the assignment and the apprentice are keyed to the Keeper and the station rather than to the triggering departure, so two departures of the same Keeper from the same station would yield one assignment and one apprentice instead of one per occasion. The wording is already the recommended "Whenever X, Y" form with explicit subjects and one finite clause per event, so no rewrite would improve it — keep the sentence as written; the fix is on our side.
good. parses as a fireable rule keyed to each qualifying occasion, with the thirty solo nights counted as a group, the Council as the assigner, and a station supplied per occasion.
